records.prompt:
Redraw the attached APPROVED game sprite (image 1) as ONE higher-resolution full-body sprite with a transparent background. This is NOT a redesign: keep the same person, face design, age, expression, pose, hand and shoulder positions, clothing, accessories and colors as image 1. Change ONLY the head size and the rendering style standard below. Image 2 Sui is ONLY adult head-to-body proportion context (about 7 heads tall), never his face, hair, build or clothes. Images 3 Minto and 4 Ageha are ONLY rendering-style references.

Character: Faris, a 24-year-old Emirati young man, tall and slim, warm brown skin, short cropped black hair, a neat thin beard line along the jaw with a small chin beard, big friendly eyes, an easy relaxed smile. Black staff polo shirt (a tiny plain patch where a shop logo would be, no letters), sand-colored chinos, thin leather cord bracelets on one wrist, white sneakers. One hand holds a small round brass tobacco tin near his chest, the other hand rests in his trouser pocket; weight on one leg. Not a real person.

HEAD SIZE (a percentage instruction barely changes the head, so use pixels): in image 1 the head is too SMALL (about 8.6 heads tall). In a figure about 1400 px tall (top of the hair to the shoe soles), the head from the top of the hair to the chin must be about 200 px (now about 162 px), and the distance from the eye line to the chin about 85 px (now about 69 px), so that he is about 7 heads tall like image 2. Enlarge the whole head, hair, ears and beard together; keep the neck and shoulders natural. Keep the total figure height, the slim build, the stance, both hands and the tin. He must still look like the same young man.

Japanese 2D visual-novel game art in the same artist's hand as the approved Minto, Ageha and Rio sprites: confident dark outlines, slightly heavier on the outer silhouette and thinner inside; flat local colors with two or three clearly shaped cel-shadow steps; a few deliberate hair highlight bands and small eye catchlights. Preserve image 1's original local colors, saturation and light-dark range. No skin gloss, airbrush gradients, rim light, glow, photographic texture, fabric micro-detail, dense ornamental noise or generic pretty-face drift.

Output ONE complete figure on a tall canvas about 1085x1450, the figure at least 1300 px tall from the hair top to the soles. Entire hair, both hands and both shoes visible with a transparent margin on every side. True RGBA transparent background, also between the limbs. No floor, cast shadow, glow, border, text, labels, grid, watermark or extra objects.
